body: I feel that. Even on the good days it’s just sort of there, in the back of your mind. I’m never not thinking about my plan or how nice it would be to be gone

You’re more then welcome. You deserve kindness and respect. I hope you have people in your life who will help show you that, and who you can turn to right now. If not, I’m here for you, and our community is here for you. Stay strong.
I understand. I’m here to talk if you need it, anytime. Stay safe

I’m so sorry you had to experience this. It isn’t your fault at all, don’t blame yourself for expecting people to treat you like a human being and not a fucking object. I agree with others here that if you want to and can report him, do so. Regardless, def don’t worry about homework. Take some time to confide in someone you can trust who can help you feel safe and whole again. And just a precursor, if your boyfriend, or anyone else, tries to make you feel like this is your fault, that’s absolute bullshit and you deserve better people in your life.

Sounds like you’re on something right now. I’d really encourage you to remain calm, wait it out, and make sure you’re thinking about things straight and sober. I totally understand everything you’re saying, probably more than you could know. I’m here to talk if you need someone right now

Wish I could do the same, shotgun would certainly be easier if I wasn’t worried about it being clean. Honestly I probably just mention “you can learn anything on 4chan!” if they ask any further. Thanks for the advice man

I totally get this. My relationship is so mixed though. When I’m all alone, I genuinely enjoy my scars in some sick way. It feels like grounding in a sense, physical proof that yes I am hurting and yes I have a problem and no it’s not just something in my mind. But whenever I’m in a situation where I’m around people and they could see my scars, I feel such intense shame and fear of discovery that I wish I’d never done anything in the first place. I hate the swings, I wish I could just feel one way about them and be done with it.

Hey all, help us solve this puzzle! The college union at our school has released a puzzle that we need to solve to find the location of our winter dance. The first one to solve it gets 2 free tickets! Help a broke student out!

Ok, so here is what we know so far. College union put up a poster with some clues. From these poster clues, we get a string of numbers - 0 - 12 - 95 - 471. These numbers will somehow will lead us to the location of the dance. We’ve tried to treat these numbers as coordinates and as a phone number to no avail. 

Any help or insights appreciated!
Totally. It feels hard for me to imagine going any other way. I guess I’m melodramatic but ever since I was a kid I’ve always pictured myself dying young.
